breaking.change: Ui installs default.css and resolves parts through the document CSS cascade. DressSet, Dressing, the legacy Selector, set_dressings, theme_dressings, default_dressings, v1_dressings and style-file dress blocks are removed. Hover and press appearance uses CSS transitions; CSS keyframe animations and transitions replay with presentation state.
breaking.fix: Write lowercase markup hosts, classes and attributes before ::part(name), with standard state pseudo-classes after it. Use background, border, color, box-shadow, border-image and transition instead of dressing declarations. Select HTML controls by their authored input type, select or textarea. The -og-material property supplies glass weight and elevation; unknown -og-* properties are errors.

breaking.change: CSS var() resolves only through the cascade, without a Theme lookup fallback. Theme::length is removed. Theme palette, spacing, radius and typography mutations write root custom properties, and widgets read their resolved values. CSS font-family accepts ordered lists of quoted names, unquoted names and generic families.
breaking.fix: Declare tokens on :root and use var(--name). Supply installed font families in fallback order. Retain CSS across UI reconstruction with inherit_part_css; it preserves root overrides at every breakpoint. The TypeScript og.ui theme API keeps its existing shape.

breaking.change: Style generation emits metadata only; it no longer emits legacy appearance or dress blocks. The dressing form of -og-frame is removed; its unrelated rive(...) form remains.
breaking.fix: Author appearance in CSS. Pure-CSS pack generation follows in phase C. Existing font, icon, sound and ornament metadata generation remains available between phases.
